title: A dark, flooded graveyard level's third message
description: Level 8 of the Jungle is dark, a graveyard and flooded at once. After the dark level's message comes the graveyard's, "THE DEAD ARE RESTLESS!", and then the lake's, which only this mix of levels shows as "YOU HEAR RUSHING WATER..." instead of "I CAN HEAR RUSHING WATER...".
